served_provenance: mapped workspace tree, no commit recorded

rules.name: expert_and_ffn_divisibility
rules.rule: Experts, MoE intermediate, and shared intermediate sizes must divide their parallel groups.

rules.name: qsa_head_divisibility
rules.rule: QSA query and KV heads must shard or replicate integrally over TP.

rules.name: max_context
rules.rule: Context must not exceed max_position_embeddings (262144).

rules.name: fp8_block_128_quantization
rules.rule: Only the block-128 FP8 checkpoint with --quantization fp8 is supported.

rules.name: vllm_dcp_flag_stays_one
rules.rule: vLLM decode_context_parallel_size CLI flag must remain 1; linear expert placement.

rules.name: pcp_unserved_not_enumerated
rules.rule: PCP > 1 requires TP1, EP, unified pool, no main-KV DCP, unpacked keys/KV, spec off; unserved and not enumerated under qwen38-full.

rules.name: pp_rules_and_prefill_mtp_producer
rules.rule: PP > 1 requires TP1, unified pool, unpacked compressed keys, and spec off, except a PD producer with PP > 1, TP1, TPU_RAIDEN_POOL_TAGS_PER_LAYER=1, QWEN4_EXP_PD_DRAFT_KV=1, and 1-token MTP.

rules.name: main_kv_dcp_env
rules.rule: Main-KV DCP is set via VLLM_TPU_QSA_MAIN_KV_DCP and must divide TP // num_key_value_heads.

rules.name: block_size_dtype_and_step_cap
rules.rule: --block-size must be 128, model dtype BF16, max_num_batched_tokens <= 8192.

rules.name: reject_disable_hybrid_kv_and_lora
rules.rule: --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager and LoRA are rejected; prefix caching requires unified pool.

rules.name: mamba_cache_mode_align
rules.rule: Unified pool + prefix caching requires mamba_cache_mode='align'; MTP accepts 'none' or 'align'.

rules.name: engram_ple_config_flags
rules.rule: engram_config flags are booleans; dp_shared_memory requires cpu_offload, local DP > 1, nnodes == 1, and not embedding_across_dp.

rules.name: mtp_constraints
rules.rule: MTP requires method='mtp', unified pool, 1 full-attention MTP layer, shared embed/lm_head, window in [1, 5], draft TP == target TP, DP == 1.

rules.name: qsa_ring_rows_and_max_spec
rules.rule: raw_ring has (indexer_compress_ratio + 7) // 8 * 8 = 8 rows (8,192 B), yielding max_qsa_speculative_tokens = 8 - 4 + 1 = 5.

rules.name: pd_decode_mtp_and_pool_tags
rules.rule: PD decode MTP requires kv_consumer, TP >= 2, PP == 1, TPU_RAIDEN_POOL_TAGS_PER_LAYER=1 (required on both pair peers whenever PP > 1 or MTP is enabled), and prefix caching off or mamba_cache_mode='align'.

rules.name: pp_stage_partition_and_last_stage_draft
rules.rule: Stage owns get_pp_indices(VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION) layers; MTP draft caches sit on the last stage.

rules.name: ple_indexing_rows_state_and_h2d
rules.rule: ple_layer_ids is 1-indexed (index + 1 in ple_layer_ids -> [2] attaches to layer 1); 16 prime head vocabs sum to 320,001,446 rounded to 128 -> 320,001,536 x 160 FP8 (47.684 GiB; 5.960 GiB/core at TP8); H2D = 2,560 B/tok (FP8 uint8); PLE conv state = (9, 10240) BF16 = 184,320 B.

rules.name: pair_leg_eight_cores_ep_fp8_raiden
rules.rule: Each PD pair leg uses Qwen4ExpRaidenConnector (producer/consumer), covers exactly 8 cores (TP x DP x PP x PCP == 8), enables EP when TP x DP x PCP > 1, uses unified pool with FP8 KV, and sets TPU_KV_RESHARD_TRANSPORT=raiden.

rules.name: ple_cpu_offload_single_host_and_sharding
rules.rule: Host PLE offload requires single host with all DP local and at most one PLE layer; HBM-resident PLE table shards evenly over TP (or TP x DP when shared). Per-pool default: cpu_offload=True on PP8/TP1 prefill, False on TP8 decode (5.96 GiB/core HBM).

rules.name: unified_pool_page_tokens_and_bytes
rules.rule: FP8 main KV = 1,024 B/tok/layer/chip (1 head slot for TP8 local_kv=1 and TP1 local_kv=2). GDN state = 8 conv + 384 ssm rows (400,896 B) at TP8 -> 512 tok/page (524,288 B/page); 64 conv + 3,072 ssm rows (3,207,168 B) at TP1 -> 3,200 tok/page (3,276,800 B/page). Compressed keys = 32 rows x 256 lanes x 2 B / 128 tok = 128 B/tok (409,600 B trimmed per 3,200-token page); stored per_rank (num_kv_heads=1).

rules.name: pd_transfer_payload
rules.rule: Wire transfer per uncached token = 12 * (1,024 + 128) = 13,824 B/tok (14,976 B/tok with QWEN4_EXP_PD_DRAFT_KV=1), plus 49 fixed REQUEST_STATE pages (36 GDN + 1 PLE + 12 QSA rings = 160,563,200 B; 50 pages = 163,840,000 B with draft ring).

rules.name: host_offload_and_multi_connector
rules.rule: Host KV offload requires TPURaidenOffloadingConnector, kv_role='kv_both', unified pool, prefix caching, mamba_cache_mode='align', positive cpu_bytes_to_use. TPUMultiConnector is admitted only as kv_producer wrapping [Qwen4ExpRaidenConnector, TPURaidenOffloadingConnector]. VLLM_TPU_OFFLOAD_TIER_CLASSES splits DRAM into per-kind tiers (key_row_bytes=409,600 B when VLLM_TPU_OFFLOAD_TIER_KEY_ROWS=1).
